2026-10-22IRCCImmigration and Refugee Protection ActRegulations Amending the Immigration and Refugee Protection Regulations (Rural Community Immigration) Regulations Amending the Immigration and Refugee Protection Regulations (Rural Community Immigration) in order to (1) establish a new rural community immigration economic class; and (2) set the eligibility requirements for permanent residency through the Rural Community Immigration Program including the responsibilities and requirements for participating communities in the program.Registration: SOR/2026-0217 Publication Date: 2026-11-18
subject: Regulations Amending the Immigration and Refugee Protection Regulations (Rural Community Immigration)
precis: Regulations Amending the Immigration and Refugee Protection Regulations (Rural Community Immigration) in order to (1) establish a new rural community immigration economic class; and (2) set the eligibility requirements for permanent residency through the Rural Community Immigration Program including the responsibilities and requirements for participating communities in the program.
